e2e.environment: dedicated resident audit Chrome via CDP 9333 (persistent profile, reused across runs); chrome-ensure reuse; one tab opened and closed; no temp Chrome/profile

modeLabel: 双人联机 + AI 补位 / 单人执白 vs AI 黑方
designer: 传统游戏 / Edmond Hoyle（1743 现代规则整理）

online.transport: HTTP/JSON + 700ms polling; server-authoritative; LAN-only by default

features.rooms: 2 seats; room id + single-use invite token + optional password
features.invite: inviteUrl uses the request Host; opens /boardgame/backgammon-premium/online.html?room=&code=
features.stateSync: stateVersion + lastAction; both viewers receive the same public board, bar/off, dice, cube and turn
features.aiFill: empty seat fills with the engine's legal-move AI; the server applies one action per tick
features.reconnect: session token + POST /api/rooms/:id/reconnect; reconnect clears timeout takeover
features.timeoutTakeover: no session request for 15s → server AI plays the seat; reconnect restores it
features.leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard?game=backgammon-premium; AI participants included; raw playerId hashed
features.idempotency: per-player idempotencyKey cached before the action guard
features.cube: double/take/pass actions are server-authoritative; pass concedes the current stake; cap 64

evidence.runAll: test-online.js is auto-discovered by node games/tests/run-all.js

shared.shuffle: N/A — dice use engine.js mulberry32-seeded RNG with injectable dice/rng
shared.sfx: games/shared/sfx.js — index.html script tag; no per-game AudioContext
shared.rules: Backgammon rules live in engine.js; no shared rules module
shared.leaderboard: shared room server keeps an anonymous in-memory board; no leaderboard copy

rules.dice: two d6; doubles are four moves; use both when legal, otherwise the higher die
rules.bar: must re-enter before any other checker; White 25−die, Black die
rules.hit: a blot goes to the bar
rules.bearOff: all 15 in home board and bar empty; exact or overshoot from the highest occupied point
rules.scoring: single ×1, gammon ×2, backgammon ×3; multiplied by the cube
rules.cube: starts 1, take/pass before rolling, cap 64, single game not a match
